tasks.title: Create a customer
tasks.goal: An operator can create a customer with a unique email address.
acceptance_criteria: A valid request returns 201 with the stored customer
A duplicate email, compared case-insensitively, returns 409

tasks.title: List customers with paging
tasks.goal: An operator sees customers in pages of 50, newest first.
acceptance_criteria: The first page holds at most 50 customers, newest first
The next-page cursor returns the following customers with no overlap

tasks.title: Send a welcome email
tasks.goal: A new customer receives a welcome email.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one welcome email is queued per created customer
tasks.open_decision: Which email provider, and may customer addresses leave the EU?
